scope: Historical preimplementation snapshot. Its static observations and NOT_RUN list describe the state before T03 acceptance and T04 implementation; docs/evidence/T04/verification.json is the current execution record.

dependencyGate.reason: T04 permits independent fixture preparation before T03 acceptance but blocks helper-dependent integration and behavior verification.

staticObservations.observation: Global Enter executes the selected item when the search input is not focused; input arrows are not routed into result navigation; Enter checks isComposing but there is no event.repeat or busy-job guard; card click executes and a separate double-click handler executes again.

Clipboard polling is 450ms; image capture resizes/encodes to PNG and fingerprints the Base64 payload before duplicate detection; selecting a stored image writes it and re-encodes PNG for its signature. No sequence-number short circuit is visible in these paths.
Filtering constructs lowercase searchable text from each item before checking whether the query is empty, so an empty query still scans item bodies.

notVerified: keyboard, IME, repeated-event, busy-state, or double-click behavior tests
clipboard sequence, image cache, worker, queue, or memory-boundary tests
lint, unit tests, real platform behavior, and controlled target-window input
